questions.question: Agree the precise wording about the characteristic function and the Lévy–Khintchine formula; check the bibliographical book titles and their established English names.

questions.question: Confirm the source of the quoted poem and agree its English translation; clarify its relationship to the four collections of 1908–1914 and the illustrated 1915 edition of Words for Which There Is No Forgiveness.

localizations.source: Confirm the source of the quoted poem and agree its English translation; clarify its relationship to the four collections of 1908–1914 and the illustrated 1915 edition of Words for Which There Is No Forgiveness.
